parameter_refs.name: lane_change_direction
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: left or right adjacent marked same-direction lane

parameter_refs.name: signal_timing
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: before or after source-lane body departure

quote: If a highway has two or more clearly marked lanes for traffic traveling in one direction, vehicles must: Not be moved from that lane until the driver has given the appropriate turn signal and ascertained that such movement can be made with safety.

activation.condition: Highway has at least two clearly marked lanes in the travel direction and the vehicle is to move from its current lane.

obligation.description: Before moving from the lane, driver must have given the appropriate turn signal and ascertained that the movement can be made with safety.

timing.description: Both prerequisites precede the movement out of the lane; no numeric lead time is stated.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Appropriate direction and display require source-bound indicator state and original camera review.

sweep_dimensions.name: appropriate_signal_lead_frames
sweep_dimensions.description: Measured appropriate lamp onset lead relative to first complete body departure.

limitations: Lamp state is not proof of camera-visible appropriate display; original pixels and legal assessment remain necessary.
No statutory numeric signal lead time is stated.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: ascertained that such movement can be made with safety
judgment_calls_needed.note: Target-lane separation and conflict trajectories are observable; driver ascertainment and legal safety remain unresolved.
